currentStatus.headline: SPENT AS AN OPERATIONAL RULE. `rules` below governed the N8 Linux deep gates at packets h, i, j and k. Do NOT apply them to a new packet without re-measuring the corpus first.
currentStatus.whyThoseThreeAreGone: All three are in BYTE_GATE_EXEMPT (e2e/visual-helpers.ts) since #298 (f8988f9, 2026-08-04). An exempt capture has no committed PNG on either platform, so three of the eleven names below no longer resolve to a file. tests/test_visual_capture_contracts.py::test_the_exempt_captures_have_no_baseline_on_either_platform is what keeps them absent.
currentStatus.whyTheHistoricalArrayIsNotRenumbered: linuxInheritedReds is a measurement, not an inventory. scripts/css_audit/p3_ceiling.py::n8_denominator() derives 11 failed / 57 passed from these eleven entries and their positions, and reconciles it against three recorded deep-gate runs (30665129779, 30663355864, 30671022691) that each really did record 11 failures. Renumbering to 8 would assert those runs failed 8 tests, which is false; measured 2026-08-29 it also raises IndexError in n8_denominator() because specs[1].files empties. The count stays 11 because 11 is what was measured. This block, not the array, carries current state.
currentStatus.statusOfTheRemainingEight: Not observed red since. #281, #294 and #308 reconciled the Linux corpus, and the 2026-08-24 scheduled deep-gate run 32688747703 (head 31659a5) compared clean with the Assert compare mode wrote no baseline step green.
currentStatus.doNotInferDeterminism: That clean compare is NOT evidence this gate can go red. The corpus was in sync, so it shows nothing WAS written, not that real drift would have been caught. Do not cite a clean committed-baseline compare as evidence of determinism.

purpose: Machine-readable reconciliation ledger for the N8 Linux deep gates at packets h, i, j and k. Every entry is a red that already existed before the WP4.4 arc began. A packet that reproduces one of these has NOT caused it.

schemaHistory.shape: `linuxInheritedReds` was a single object bound to one `snapshotDir`, with one `count`, one `evidence` string and one flat `files` array.

schemaHistory.reason: The v1 shape could describe exactly one spec file. The N8 deep gate reds eleven tests, not ten: the ten `visual.spec.ts` baselines v1 already carried, plus `visual-baseline-thumbnails.spec.ts › plan-desktop-light-advanced`, which lives in a different snapshot directory and which v1 had no slot for. Because the ledger's own rules make an unlisted red a rollback trigger, that omission turned a known-inherited red into a false rollback trigger for every future CSS packet. v2 makes the ledger multi-spec so the omission is structurally fixable rather than repeatable.
schemaHistory.change: `linuxInheritedReds` is now `{platform, totalCount, specs[]}`. Each element of `specs[]` carries its own `spec`, `snapshotDir`, `count`, `evidence`, `provenance` and `files`, so the ledger can cover any number of spec files. `snapshotDir`, `count`, `evidence`, `allDesktopVariants`, `note` and `files` moved from the `linuxInheritedReds` object into the `specs[0]` entry unchanged.
schemaHistory.rebaseline: None. No snapshot file was regenerated, modified or deleted by this revision. The ten v1 entries are carried over byte-for-byte; the eleventh is ADDED coverage of an already-measured inherited red, not a new baseline.
schemaHistory.authority: Correcting the committed Linux ledger requires owner approval (V2, R3 condition 6). This revision is proposal P1 from `docs/CSS_PHASE4_WP4_4_K_INTEGRATION_EVIDENCE.md` §5 and must not land without it.

schemaHistory.reason: The ledger had become irreproducible as a live rule while staying correct as history. Three of its eleven files were retired by #298 four days after v2 was written, and nothing validated the list, so the drift was invisible. Left alone, the rule A red on a file NOT in this ledger is a rollback trigger reads as current operational truth over a set that can no longer be reproduced.
schemaHistory.change: Additive only. currentStatus records the measured 8-of-11 present, why the three are gone, and why the historical array is not renumbered; rules gains a leading supersession notice; schemaVersion 2 -> 3. No entry in linuxInheritedReds, uncertifiableElements or visualMatrix was altered, reordered or removed.
schemaHistory.rebaseline: None. No snapshot file was regenerated, modified or deleted.
schemaHistory.authority: V1 owner ruling, 2026-08-29 - documentation reconciliation authorized; implementation and regeneration withheld.

rules: SUPERSEDED 2026-08-29 - see currentStatus. The six rules below are retained as the N8-era contract they were. Three of the eleven files they govern no longer exist, so none of them may be applied to a new packet without re-measuring the corpus first.
These reds are inherited. Do not attribute them to the packet under test.
Do NOT rebaseline them. Correcting the committed Linux ledger is a separate change needing owner approval (V2, R3 condition 6).
A red on a file NOT in this ledger is a real finding and a rollback trigger.
The animated-logo red remains a band, never an exact pixel count (M7).

Scope is per spec file. A red is covered only when its spec appears in `linuxInheritedReds.specs[].spec` AND its baseline appears in that same entry's `files`. A red in a covered spec but on an uncovered file is still a real finding and a rollback trigger.
Adding a spec entry requires the same proof the existing entries carry: the red must reproduce on a commit that does not contain the packet under test. Record that commit in the entry's `provenance`.

linuxInheritedReds.totalCountNote: Eleven reds across two spec files. The N8 deep gate reported exactly this set at three separate refs — `1019d34` (run 30665129779), i + corrective (run 30663355864) and j (run 30671022691) — with identical failure identities each time.

specs.evidence: The visual-linux deep gate (run 30288077299, run_visual=true, visual_mode=generate) regenerated all 84 Linux baselines. The 6 /fatigue captures were new and were committed under N7; the other 60 were compared against the committed ledger WITHOUT being written. Ten differ.
specs.note: Every drifting baseline is a `desktop` variant (1440x900). No `mobile` or `tablet` baseline drifted. Differences are roughly 0.1% of file size.

specs.evidence: The N8 deep gate (visual_mode=compare) was dispatched against `1019d34` — a commit predating the whole i–k tail — and reported `visual-baseline-thumbnails.spec.ts › plan-desktop-light-advanced` as failed, with the same identity it carries on i and on j. A red that reproduces on a tree containing none of the packets under test is inherited by definition. It failed all three Playwright retries at every ref, so it is deterministic rather than a flake.
specs.note: Like the ten `visual.spec.ts` entries, the only drifting variant is `desktop`. The `mobile` and `tablet` thumbnails and the `simple` and `dark` desktop variants of the same page all pass.
specs.addedReason: v1 declared its scope as `visual.spec.ts-snapshots` and had no slot for a second spec, so this red — already measured as inherited — fell under the ledger's own `A red on a file NOT in this ledger is a real finding and a rollback trigger` rule. Every future CSS packet would have hit that false trigger.

provenance.provenInheritedAtCommitSubject: test(e2e): stop the dark surface flattener owning the Progression table borders (#211)
provenance.whyThatCommitProvesIt: `1019d34` contains no packet from the WP4.4 i–k tail, so a red that reproduces there cannot have been caused by i, j or k.

uncertifiableElements.evidence: Rest-state differential over 11 routes x 2 themes. These elements run animations with `animation-iteration-count: infinite`, so two captures taken a frame apart legitimately disagree and no rest state exists to compare.
uncertifiableElements.rule: NO downstream packet may classify a declaration affecting these elements as dead on the authority of the rest-state harness. Certifying them requires a different instrument, proposed and approved separately.
uncertifiableElements.adjacentNote: `div.developer-credit-banner` carries an infinite animation on its `::before` pseudo-element. It is NOT in the element list, because the animation belongs to the pseudo-element and the host element's own `animation-name` computes to `none`. A packet touching that banner's pseudo-element paint must treat it as uncertifiable too.

visualMatrix.changedBy: N7 added /fatigue; the matrix was 60 before Packet a.
visualMatrix.note: Downstream gates that say 'the full 60-test matrix' mean 66.
visualMatrix.scopeNote: This matrix describes `visual.spec.ts` only, and it is NOT the whole of what the N8 gate runs. The `visual-linux` job in `.github/workflows/deep-gate.yml` invokes `e2e/visual.spec.ts e2e/visual-baseline-thumbnails.spec.ts` together, so the thumbnails matrix is inside every N8 result quoted against this ledger. Reading `testsPerPlatform: 66` as the gate's total is what let the eleventh red go unledgered until schema v2.
